'''Broo Tarquin''' is a ship Engineer based at '''Broo's Legacy''' in the '''Muang''' system. The former founder and chief designer of Dead-Eye Defence Systems now operates a workshop devoted to laser weapons.<ref name="edwiki-broo">[https://elite-dangerous.fandom.com/wiki/Broo_Tarquin Broo Tarquin], Elite Dangerous Wiki. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref>

Broo provides '''Grade 5''' engineering for [[Beam Laser|Beam Lasers]], [[Burst Laser|Burst Lasers]], and [[Pulse Laser|Pulse Lasers]].<ref name="inara-broo">[https://inara.cz/elite/engineer/15/ Broo Tarquin — Engineer], INARA. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref>

== Location ==

* '''System:''' Muang
* '''Body:''' Muang 5 a
* '''Facility:''' Broo's Legacy
* '''Engineer scope:''' Ship laser weapons
* '''Referral required:''' [[Hera Tani]]
* '''System permit required:''' No

== Access requirements ==

Access to Broo Tarquin has three stages:<ref name="inara-broo" />

# Reach '''Grade 3 access plus at least one-third progress toward Grade 4''' with [[Hera Tani]] to receive his referral.
# Reach the Pilots Federation '''Combat rank of Competent or higher'''.
# Provide '''50 units of [[Fujin Tea]]''' at Broo's Legacy.

The referral, Combat rank, and commodity contribution are separate conditions. The complete ordered process and Fujin Tea acquisition guidance belong to [[Unlocking Broo Tarquin]].

== Workshop reputation ==

Reputation with Broo Tarquin increases by:<ref name="inara-broo" />

* crafting modifications at his workshop; or
* handing in bounty vouchers at Broo's Legacy.

Higher reputation opens the grades that Broo supports. INARA notes that station services may not appear immediately after the first unlock; beginning a new game session can make those services available.<ref name="inara-broo" />

=== Operations-era services ===

Current Live records add five Operations-era services to Broo's workshop:<ref name="frontier-operations">[https://www.elitedangerous.com/news/updates/4-4-0-0 Elite Dangerous: Operations — Update Notes], Frontier Developments, 30 June 2026. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref><ref name="inara-broo" />

* '''Beam Laser:''' Overloaded and Plasma Conversion through Grade 5<ref name="inara-overloaded">[https://inara.cz/elite/blueprint/226/ Beam Laser — Overloaded], INARA. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref><ref name="inara-beam-plasma">[https://inara.cz/elite/blueprint/203/ Beam Laser — Plasma Conversion], INARA. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref>
* '''Burst Laser:''' Regenerative and Plasma Conversion through Grade 5<ref name="inara-regenerative">[https://inara.cz/elite/blueprint/228/ Burst Laser — Regenerative], INARA. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref><ref name="inara-burst-plasma">[https://inara.cz/elite/blueprint/202/ Burst Laser — Plasma Conversion], INARA. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref>
* '''Pulse Laser:''' Plasma Conversion through Grade 5<ref name="inara-pulse-plasma">[https://inara.cz/elite/blueprint/204/ Pulse Laser — Plasma Conversion], INARA. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref>

These services are not part of Legacy Engineering. The Regenerative record remains incompletely documented by INARA, so this article does not assign it unconfirmed modifier values. Exact modifiers, costs, and compatibility belong to the corresponding [[Engineering Blueprints|Blueprint]] records.

== Blueprint pinning and remote work ==

After sufficient reputation has been earned, one Broo Tarquin blueprint can be pinned for use through [[Remote Engineering]]. A pinned blueprint cannot exceed the grade he offers, and Experimental Effects still require an appropriate workshop visit.

== Direct referrals ==

Current Engineer records do not identify another Engineer whose discovery requirement comes directly from Broo Tarquin. His active referral branch therefore ends at his workshop.<ref name="inara-broo" />
